home.lead.zh: 直接在裝置上開啟 CAD 圖面、PDF 與壓縮檔。
home.lead.en: Open CAD drawings, PDFs and archives right on your device.

home.tagline.zh: 簡單好操作~輕鬆看CAD圖面
home.tagline.en: Easy to use, easy to read CAD drawings

viewer.librarySaveFailed.zh: 檔案已開啟，但無法存入圖面庫，請檢查裝置空間。
viewer.librarySaveFailed.en: The file opened but couldn't be saved to the library. Check the device storage.

error.archiveOpen.zh: 無法讀取壓縮檔，可能損毀或格式不受支援。
error.archiveOpen.en: The archive can't be read. It may be damaged or in an unsupported format.

error.dwg.export.zh: DWG 已讀取，但無法產生可顯示的有效圖面。
error.dwg.export.en: The DWG was read, but no valid drawing could be produced from it.

error.dwg.generic.zh: 這張 DWG 解析時出錯，無法開啟（不是手機記憶體不足）。可在電腦 CAD 開啟後另存新檔再試。
error.dwg.generic.en: This DWG hit an error while being read and can't be opened (it is not the phone running out of memory). Open it in desktop CAD, save it as a new file and try again.

error.dwg.header.zh: 無法讀取 DWG 檔頭，檔案可能損毀、不完整或受保護。
error.dwg.header.en: The DWG header can't be read. The file may be damaged, incomplete or protected.

error.dwg.memory.zh: 圖面超過此裝置可供 DWG 引擎使用的記憶體。
error.dwg.memory.en: The drawing needs more memory than this device gives the DWG engine.

error.dwg.parse.zh: DWG 包含目前引擎無法讀取的資料或圖面物件。
error.dwg.parse.en: The DWG contains data or objects the engine can't read.

error.dwg.runtime.zh: 此版本缺少離線 DWG 引擎，請重新安裝完整版本。
error.dwg.runtime.en: This build is missing the offline DWG engine. Reinstall the full version.

error.dwg.timeout.zh: DWG 轉換時間過長，已停止。
error.dwg.timeout.en: The DWG conversion took too long and was stopped.

error.dwg.version.zh: 目前繪圖引擎不支援此 DWG 版本。
error.dwg.version.en: This DWG version isn't supported by the drawing engine.

error.dxfOpen.zh: 無法開啟 DXF 檔案。
error.dxfOpen.en: The DXF file can't be opened.

error.emptyFile.zh: 檔案是空的，請選擇完整檔案。
error.emptyFile.en: The file is empty. Choose a complete file.

error.fileRead.en: The selected file can't be read.

error.pdfOpen.zh: 無法開啟或繪製 PDF，檔案可能損毀，或需更新 Android System WebView。
error.pdfOpen.en: The PDF can't be opened or drawn. It may be damaged, or Android System WebView may need an update.

error.pdfPassword.zh: 此版本不支援密碼保護的 PDF，請開啟已解鎖的副本。
error.pdfPassword.en: Password-protected PDFs aren't supported. Open an unlocked copy.

error.render.en: This device can't draw the drawing.

error.tooLarge.zh: 檔案超過 128 MB 安全上限，請開啟較小的圖面。
error.tooLarge.en: The file is over the 128 MB safety limit. Open a smaller drawing.

error.unsupportedFormat.zh: 請選擇 DXF、DWG、PDF、PNG、JPG、ZIP 或 RAR 檔案。
error.unsupportedFormat.en: Choose a DXF, DWG, PDF, PNG, JPG, ZIP or RAR file.

measure.howto.angle.zh: 依序點選起點、角度頂點及終點。
measure.howto.angle.en: Tap the start point, the vertex, then the end point.

measure.howto.area.zh: 依序點選至少三個邊界點，末點會連回起點。
measure.howto.area.en: Tap at least three boundary points in order; the last one joins back to the first.

measure.howto.distance.zh: 點選兩點；再點會保留這段並量下一段。長按可精確對準。拖曳平移，雙指縮放。
measure.howto.distance.en: Tap two points; tap again to keep this one and measure the next. Long-press to aim precisely. Drag to pan, pinch to zoom.

measure.howto.object.zh: 點選幾何物件讀取長度；文字、標註、填充及實體面僅查詢屬性，不以繪製邊界冒充工程數值。
measure.howto.object.en: Tap a geometric object to read its length. Text, dimensions, hatches and solids show properties only, never their drawn outline as an engineering value.

measure.howto.path.zh: 沿路徑依序點選各點，圖上會標出每段長度。長按可精確對準。拖曳平移，雙指縮放。
measure.howto.path.en: Tap the points along the path in order; each segment's length is shown. Long-press to aim precisely. Drag to pan, pinch to zoom.

measure.noObject.zh: 附近沒有支援的物件，請放大或使用點選量測。
measure.noObject.en: No supported object nearby. Zoom in or measure by tapping points.

measure.snapLimited.zh: 大型圖面的物件鎖點有限制，仍可點選量測。
measure.snapLimited.en: Object snap is limited on large drawings; tapping still measures.

measure.unknownUnit.zh: 檔案沒有可辨識的單位，請先選擇繪圖單位，再讀取實際長度。
measure.unknownUnit.en: The file has no recognizable unit. Choose the drawing unit first to read real lengths.

library.deleteDrawingBody.zh: 此圖面將從應用程式圖面庫移除。
library.deleteDrawingBody.en: The drawing will be removed from the app's library.

library.deleteFolderBody.zh: 此資料夾及其中所有項目都將移除。
library.deleteFolderBody.en: The folder and everything in it will be removed.

library.emptyBody.zh: 加入 DXF、DWG、PDF、ZIP 或 RAR 檔案。
library.emptyBody.en: Add DXF, DWG, PDF, ZIP or RAR files.

library.err.invalidDestination.zh: 無法使用此目的資料夾。
library.err.invalidDestination.en: This destination folder can't be used.

library.err.invalidFile.zh: 檔案為空、無法讀取或格式不受支援。
library.err.invalidFile.en: The file is empty, unreadable or in an unsupported format.

library.err.invalidName.zh: 請使用不含斜線或控制字元的有效名稱。
library.err.invalidName.en: Use a valid name without slashes or control characters.

library.err.nameExists.en: An item with this name already exists.

library.err.notFound.zh: 圖面庫中已無此項目，請重新加入圖面。
library.err.notFound.en: This item is no longer in the library. Add the drawing again.

library.err.storageFull.zh: 裝置儲存空間不足，無法儲存圖面。
library.err.storageFull.en: Not enough storage on this device to save the drawing.

library.err.tooLarge.zh: 檔案超過 128 MB 安全上限，請開啟較小的圖面。
library.err.tooLarge.en: The file is over the 128 MB safety limit. Open a smaller drawing.

library.err.unavailable.zh: 此裝置無法使用圖面庫。
library.err.unavailable.en: The drawing library isn't available on this device.

library.noResults.zh: 沒有符合的檔案或資料夾

library.subtitle.zh: 離線圖面、PDF 與壓縮檔

archive.body.zh: 選擇要解壓縮至圖面庫的圖面與 PDF。
archive.body.en: Choose the drawings and PDFs to extract to the library.

archive.err.encrypted.zh: 不支援加密或分割壓縮檔，請使用單一且未加密的壓縮檔。
archive.err.encrypted.en: Encrypted or split archives aren't supported. Use a single, unencrypted archive.

archive.err.invalidPath.zh: 壓縮檔包含無效路徑，無法匯入。
archive.err.invalidPath.en: The archive contains an invalid path and can't be imported.

archive.err.limit.zh: 壓縮檔超過檔案數量或解壓縮大小上限，請減少選取項目。
archive.err.limit.en: The archive exceeds the file count or extracted size limit. Select fewer items.

archive.noneSupported.zh: 壓縮檔中沒有 DXF、DWG 或 PDF。
archive.noneSupported.en: The archive has no DXF, DWG or PDF files.

archive.unsupportedEntry.en: This file type can't be viewed

library.webNote.zh: 網頁版：圖面存在這個瀏覽器裡。清除瀏覽器資料，或 iPhone 長期未開啟時，可能被系統刪除；原檔請另外保存。
library.webNote.en: Web version: drawings are stored in this browser. Clearing browser data, or not opening it on an iPhone for a long time, may delete them; keep your original files elsewhere.

library.snapshotNote.zh: 圖面庫是匯入快照，不能自動同步外部檔案。「重新命名／重新解析」不會讀取外部新版。
library.snapshotNote.en: The library keeps a snapshot of each import and can't sync outside files. Rename or re-parse won't read a newer outside version.

library.replaceNote.zh: 選擇同格式新版後替換此項內容並重解析；保留圖庫名稱、其他圖面與閱讀偏好。
library.replaceNote.en: Choose a newer file of the same format to replace this item and re-parse it; the library name, other drawings and reading preferences are kept.
